sa_s137_ferries.desc: ferry in white with FERRIES 80 F cut out in blue (1010 long, 250 high) (traced from the sheet's filled artwork)

notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. DIT symbol sheet (Symbol Series: a sign component published as its own drawing; used on service, tourist and warning signs at the percentage each sign sheet states). Sheet S137 (ferry / ferries, coastal waters): 1190 x 350; the plate is drawn with FERRIES — the sheet gives FERRY (330 wide, 80 F) as the alternative legend, not generated. The whole white ferry with its cut-out lettering is traced. Layout: 1190 x 350, blue, R0, no border. Legend placed from the sheet's own filled artwork measured at 1200 dpi (letter heights from the ink, series confirmed by the FHWA widths, each word centred on its ink; the sheet's dimension chains were not transcribed one by one for this sign — the positions are the sheet's drawn artwork itself, which the overlay check confirms): symbol ferry in white with FERRIES 80 F cut out in blue (1010 long, 250 high) x 90-1100 y 51-300.
